findings.explanation: The selected patrol district is generalized instead of named.

findings.governingReading: before we are caught off guard or have the ground cut from under us
findings.explanation: A warning about being tactically wrong-footed becomes a vague possibility that something may happen.

findings.evidenceJa: 目に見えて判るような異状はないでしょう
findings.governingReading: there probably will be no abnormality visible to the eye
findings.explanation: Saber’s forecast before a careful search is promoted into an established fact.

findings.governingReading: the residential area on the Western-mansion side
findings.explanation: A concrete patrol sector is generalized.

findings.highlight: a strong wave of magical energy
findings.governingReading: the aftershock of powerful magical energy
findings.explanation: Evidence left in the wake of an event becomes a generic wave.

findings.highlight: find it on the first day
findings.evidenceJa: 一日目で当たりを引く
findings.governingReading: draw a hit on the very first night out
findings.explanation: Shirou’s idiom for unexpectedly encountering real trouble becomes a vague discovery.

findings.highlight: I never thought that I might have to do it myself
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が殺す事を考えてもいな
findings.governingReading: I had not even considered killing someone myself
findings.explanation: The feared act of personally killing is left to an indistinct pronoun.

findings.highlight: the victim will not live long
findings.evidenceJa: 襲われた者は助からないでしょう
findings.governingReading: the person attacked will not be saved if this continues
findings.explanation: The immediate prospect of rescue failure becomes a prediction that the victim will survive for only a short time.

findings.highlight: The numbness throughout my body disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 固まっていた頭、手足の痺れが解ける
findings.governingReading: my frozen mind and the numbness in my hands and feet release
findings.explanation: The mental paralysis and specifically numb extremities collapse into generalized bodily numbness.

findings.highlight: The fear that I might kill
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いをするのだ、という恐れ
findings.governingReading: the fear of entering a fight to the death
findings.explanation: Fear of reciprocal mortal combat is reassigned solely to Shirou killing someone.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分の不甲斐なさを詫びて
findings.governingReading: I apologize for my own pathetic inadequacy
findings.explanation: Shirou condemns his failure to act; the English supplies the narrower moral trait cowardice.

findings.governingReading: I break into a full-speed run
findings.explanation: Shirou’s own recovered action is reassigned to both him and Saber.

findings.highlight: where we will fight someone to the death
findings.evidenceJa: 不吉な魔力が残る殺し合いの場へ
findings.governingReading: toward the scene of mortal combat where ominous magical energy lingers
findings.explanation: The lingering magical evidence and destination already marked by violence are omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 走り出す足は震えている
findings.governingReading: the feet carrying me into a run are trembling
findings.explanation: The contradiction of running on trembling feet becomes static generalized shaking.

findings.governingReading: that fear is right or proper
findings.explanation: Shirou’s ethical validation of fear becomes a statistical claim of normality.

findings.highlight: If I have a reason to fight, I must believe in it
findings.evidenceJa: 戦うと決めた理由があるのなら、まずそれを抱かなければならなかった
findings.governingReading: if I have a reason I chose to fight, I first have to take that desire into myself
findings.explanation: The need to arm himself emotionally with his reason becomes generic belief in it.

findings.highlight: If my enemies are arming their minds with “the desire for the Holy Grail”
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が“聖杯が欲しい”という願望で心を武装するのなら
findings.governingReading: if an opponent arms their heart with the desire to possess the Grail
findings.explanation: The immediate singular opponent becomes plural enemies, and heart is changed to mind.

findings.governingReading: the desire to stop the fighting
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resolve toward the present violence is expanded into ending every conflict.
